charge_port.notes: Guide Auto (Canada): standard NACS charge port on the front right fender, all 2026 Subaru EVs.

supercharger_access.notes: Estimated: Subaru US 2026 Solterra release (same NACS lineup): Superchargers open to Subaru EVs; no Subaru page names this car.
Estimated: InsideEVs list of non-Tesla EVs that can use Superchargers includes the Subaru Trailseeker and Uncharted.
Estimated: Drive Tesla Canada relays Subaru: Superchargers available to Subaru EV owners in Canada and the US through the SubaruConnect app (Solterra); 2026 Subaru EVs have native NACS.
